findings.claim: diff.suppressBlankEmpty=true is not neutralized by the four pins (no CLI flag exists); an empty context line is skipped by the parser, shifting lineNumber and carrying a totem-ignore-next-line across a blank line so a violation is suppressed
findings.counterexample: branch dist, pinned getGitDiffRange: default [console.log(1);,4,''] vs suppressBlankEmpty [console.log(1);,3,'// totem-ignore-next-line']

findings.claim: JSDoc on exported GIT_DIFF_PORCELAIN_ARGS says list-form diffs carry the list and the census needs no exemption table; code leaves them unpinned and the census exempts them via LIST_FORM_FLAGS; test header also lists -z as flag-exempt though LIST_FORM_FLAGS lacks it
findings.counterexample: git-porcelain.test.ts:132 LIST_FORM_FLAGS; cli git.ts getNameStatus/getShortstat unpinned

findings.claim: --no-ext-diff does not disable diff.<driver>.textconv; pinned git diff and git log -p print textconv output while blob reads print raw content; a failing textconv makes the diff fatal
findings.counterexample: *.txt diff=up with textconv sed y/abcd/ABCD/: pinned diff shows +D, git show HEAD:f.txt shows a, --no-textconv shows +d

findings.claim: diff.relative=true rewrites header paths and drops outside changes when cwd is a subdirectory; pins do not neutralize it, --no-relative would; also affects --name-only so the exemption measurement is bounded
findings.counterexample: from subdir b/: pinned diff prints diff --git a/x.ts b/x.ts for repo path b/x.ts

findings.claim: census reach is narrower than the changeset's 'refuses any new patch-producing git diff spawn'
findings.counterexample: missed: ['diff'], double quotes, ['-C', dir, 'diff', ...], log --patch/-u/--stat/--cc, ['log', refs[0], '-p'], ['diff','--stat','--numstat'] (coloured yet exempt)

findings.claim: design invariant names 5 readers under each of 5 settings; behavioral tests cover 5 reader-setting pairs and getDiffBetween only by mocked argv
diff.context=0 (or GIT_DIFF_OPTS) leaves precedingLine null for the first addition of a hunk so a totem-ignore-next-line on an unchanged line is missed (fail-closed false FAIL); -U3 would pin it
does diff.submodule=diff inline submodule patches into the gate's diff; unmeasured; --submodule=short would pin it

verdict: blocking=0 material=2 minor=5 question=1; convergence named on the pin mechanism for its named settings (placement, census position, exemptions measured); F1 is an un-flaggable same-class gap the seat should rule fold-or-file
